    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen, objs = set(), []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color and (r, c) not in seen:
                stack = [(r, c)]
                seen.add((r, c))
                cells = []
                while stack:
                    y, x = stack.pop()
                    cells.append((y, x))
                    for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                        q = (y + dy, x + dx)
                        if (0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w and q not in seen
                                and grid[q[0]][q[1]] == color):
                            seen.add(q)
                            stack.append(q)
                minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
                minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
                shape = {(y - minr, x - minc) for y, x in cells}
                height = max(y for y, x in shape) + 1
                width = max(x for y, x in shape) + 1
                objs.append((minc, color, shape, height, width))
    objs.sort(key=lambda obj: obj[0])
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    top = left = 0
    prev_height = prev_width = None
    for i, (_, color, shape, height, width) in enumerate(objs):
        if i:
            top += prev_height - 1
            left += prev_width - 1
        for y, x in shape:
            yy, xx = top + y, left + x
            if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w:
                out[yy][xx] = color
        prev_height, prev_width = height, width
    return out
